QuestInfo.name: [Medal] Ariant Culture Expert
QuestInfo.0: Culture expert #b#p2101005##k is currently researching #m260000000# and needs your help.
QuestInfo.1:
Help culture expert #p2101005# research the Ariant culture.
Talk to the residents to gain information about the sultan and the greedy queen, the Sand Bandits, and the Red Scorpions.
QuestInfo.2: You successfully learned more about the cause of the recent atmospheric change around #m260000000#.

0.0: Since you've been recognized as a denizen of Ariant... Could you help me with my research?

yes.0: Wonderful! The lack of fresh air around here was starting to slow me down! I can really use the help. Converse with the townspeople to learn about their culture and report back to me!

no.0: That's too bad. Cultural studies are a rather important subject, you know.

1.0: Did you learn any new and interesting facts?

yes.0: Wow, you've clearly formed a deep bond with the people of Ariant!\r\nHow amazing! You've advanced my research immeasurably quickly!

default.0: Intriguing! But I still need to know more. Pay particular attention to their folk tales and such!
